headline: Presidents Cup Sunday Singles: 12 matches decide the cup at Medinah Course No. 3
whyCareReason: The Presidents Cup comes down to Sunday Singles at Medinah No. 3. 12 points on the line as Scheffler, Matsuyama, Scott, and Cantlay clash.
teaser: Sunday 27 September at Medinah: 12 singles matches to decide the 16th Presidents Cup. Team USA aims to reach 15.5 points; Internationals seek historic rally.
story:
Why this one matters: The 16th Presidents Cup reaches its final verdict on Sunday 27 September with 12 decisive singles matches across Medinah Country Club's Course No. 3.

After a grueling 36-hole Moving Day marathon, Captains Brandt Snedeker and Geoff Ogilvy set their final day order of play. Twelve individual matches will determine whether Team USA retains the golden trophy or if the International Team produces a historic comeback.

World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler leads off for the Americans in a premier matchup against 2021 Masters champion Hideki Matsuyama. Veteran Adam Scott, playing his 12th cup, takes on Patrick Cantlay in match two. Xander Schauffele squares off against Sungjae Im, followed by Collin Morikawa versus Min Woo Lee. With 15.5 points needed for victory, Sunday singles at Medinah will be relentless.
stakes: 12 points at stake in Sunday singles. First team to 15.5 points wins the Presidents Cup.
rivalryAngle: Team USA dominance versus International determination on Chicago's most famous championship stage.
